findingClass: an incoming IPO record held for review by the OD-68 create-time hold (a same-name, same-segment live row with a differing KNOWN open date or price band) that no human has decided — invisible anywhere else, so the offering it describes never gets a row or a correction
failThreshold: any audit_logs IDENTITY_HELD_FOR_REVIEW row in the last 2 days whose incoming slug has no later IDENTITY_HOLD_OVERRIDDEN row
unverifiableWhen: never — always runs against the audit_logs table
note: PR #910 review round 1, MAJOR-2: a warn log alone is not detection (signal-ownership.md R3). IPORepository.create writes one audit_logs row per held record per candidate per day; this check lists every undecided one by name. A human decides by correcting the existing row, or by creating the record through /admin (the web admin route is not held) or IPORepository.create(..., { identityHoldOverride }).
